ValidationRule.description: An Entirely lead cannot be qualified or converted until Selling Company and Territory are filled in. Lead conversion is covered because the org has Require Validation for Converted Leads enabled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "RLM_Entirely_Lead", OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), IsConverted ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_Selling_Company__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_Territory__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Selling Company and Territory before qualifying or converting this lead.
